title: UI/UX DESIGNER
summary: Research, design and improve user experiences for ERP and enterprise software products, from workflows and wireframes through responsive interfaces and prototypes.

seo.metaTitle: UI/UX DESIGNER Career | Sunny Diamonds
seo.metaDescription: Research, design and improve user experiences for ERP and enterprise software products.

jobSummary.sectionContent: The UI/UX Designer will research, design and improve the user experience of ERP and enterprise software products. The role translates business workflows and user requirements into responsive interfaces, wireframes and prototypes, and works closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Developers and QA teams throughout the software development lifecycle.

rolesAndResponsibilities.sectionContent:
UI Design & Design Systems

  • Design modern, responsive web interfaces for ERP applications, including dashboards, forms, reports, workflow screens and admin panels.
  • Create reusable design systems and UI component libraries, and maintain consistency across SPR DigitalLab products.
  • Design responsive layouts for desktop, tablet and mobile devices.

UX Design, Flows & Prototyping

  • Study business workflows, user requirements and user behaviour to identify usability needs.
  • Create user journeys, information architecture, user flows and wireframes.
  • Develop low-fidelity and high-fidelity prototypes before development begins.
  • Improve navigation and interaction patterns based on user feedback and usability observations.

Collaboration & Development Handoff

  • Work closely with Product Owners / Product Managers and Business Analysts to understand business requirements.
  • Coordinate with Developers and QA teams during implementation and participate in sprint planning and product discussions.
  • Prepare clear design specifications and hand over designs for development.
  • Review implemented screens for design accuracy and suggest usability improvements.

Design Standards, Quality & Documentation

  • Maintain brand guidelines and ensure accessibility and usability standards are followed.
  • Apply Material Design or Bootstrap design principles where appropriate.
  • Create pixel-perfect UI designs and maintain design documentation throughout development.
  • Support consistency, browser compatibility and responsive behaviour across enterprise web applications.
